messages:
Sofia M.: @Auditor_Lee  quick q from your evidence list: you requested 'KMS request logs + RBAC change artifacts (90d)'. Preference for raw CloudTrail vs our prepackaged evidence bundle?

Auditor_Lee: Bundle is fine. Need per-request principal, key-id, action, outcome, rotation events, and any auth failures. Also attach a control crosswalk to SOC2/ISO control IDs.

Ravi P.: We can assemble kms-requests.csv, kms-rotations.json, rbac-changes.csv, approval-artifacts.zip, index.md (control mapping). ETA: today EOD. Note: one ingestion gap in ap-southeast-1 on 2024-10-20; backfill done.

Jules (infra): Packaging plan: s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1765439998/{kms-requests.csv,kms-rotations.json,rbac-changes.csv,approval-artifacts.zip,index.md,backfill.log}. index.md will map files to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9 and include short rationale.

Sofia M.: RBAC change PR: https://github.com/redwood/platform-admin/pull/2222  shows removal of legacy service account and approver. Will attach git log and approver Slack confirm.

Ravi P.: Export snippet for reproducibility:
```
# Splunk example
splunk search "index=cloudtrail sourcetype=aws:kms (ActionName=Decrypt OR ActionName=GenerateDataKey OR ActionName=ReEncrypt)" -earliest "-90d" | outputcsv kms-requests.csv
aws s3 cp kms-requests.csv s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1765439998/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

Auditor_Lee: Please include 3 redacted KMS rows (principals redacted but schema intact) for sampling. Also flag any auth failures and show rotation timestamps.

Ravi P.: Sample (redacted): `principal:user:REDACTED, keyid:arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:555566667777:key/abcd-1111, action:Decrypt, time:2024-09-30T07:22:11Z, result:Allowed`  will include 3 signed rows.

Oncall-Bot: INC-2024-512 collector gap in ap-southeast-1 2024-10-20T02:05-02:20 UTC  backfill completed by jules at 2024-10-20T09:01:03Z, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1765439998/backfill.log :white_check_mark:

Sofia M.: Context note: RBAC tighten was part of mitigations for CVE-2024-9999 affecting lib-crypto. Triage doc, patch PR, canary rollout notes included in approval-artifacts.zip.

Auditor_Lee: Great. Once you upload I will validate and follow up if anything is missing. DM me for urgent clarifications.

Ravi P.: Will upload and post S3 path here in ~45m. :thumbsup:
